data_fields.name: summon_day_table
data_fields.donor_constant: 16 entries, one unique dayOfYear each (1 to 350)

data_fields.name: summon_weather_bonus
data_fields.donor_constant: 30 when cond None, or matching rain or thunder

best_idea: A summon is a gated service: a day table picks the entity, the price falls with the sponsor's reputation, the chance rises with the player's reputation with that entity (30 + rep + 30 bonus on matching weather), the price is paid before the roll, a replacement roll can swap the entity, and a failed roll can spawn an ambush.
decision_why: Keep the day gate, price, chance, replacement roll and once-only flag, but move the roll to the server, clamp the chance, floor the price, and make the refund rule an explicit data field (the donor has no refund).
acceptance: A server test on a matching day, with enough gold, at a chance of 60: seeded rolls 1 to 60 summon the entity and rolls 61 to 100 fail; the gold is spent in both cases; a second success for the same entity returns already-summoned with no second quest.
